notes.title: Update Notes for 10/31/24: New Images!
notes.content:
Happy Halloween! 

The nine puzzles for the History theme have been added.

Please remember that you can hold you right mouse button down + scroll wheel to adjust the zoom level.

notes.title: Update Notes 9/12/24
notes.content:
Controller support! 
If you are playing on Steam deck you will want to add a custom key binding for right mouse and scroll wheel to be able to zoom in and out.

If you are playing on Keyboard, your manual zoom is Right mouse hold + scroll wheel

Improved soundtrack!
Lengthened our original soundtrack so that there is less looping for a long coloring session

Bug fixes!
Performance, improved visibility of numbers, etc
